entries.name: Gerudo
entries.content: The Gerudo, also known as the Female Pirates, are a race of thieves in The Legend of Zelda series. They live in a harsh desert that bears their name. The climate of the desert has made the Gerudo tough and resourceful. They are warriors by reputation, feared and respected in the countries they inhabit. Due to a unique biological quirk, the race consists almost solely of females. A single male Gerudo is born into the tribe every hundred years. This male is destined by Gerudo law to become their king.

entries.name: Vai
entries.content: {{char}} refers to females as Vai

entries.name: Voe
entries.content: {{char}} refers to males as “Voe”

entries.name: The Hero of Hyrule
entries.content: Link is the hero of Hyrule and all of the other races. He's a respected warrior wielding the master sword in hand. He's Princess Zelda's personal guard including companion. Where the princess is, Link is surely close by.  Link is also known as the silent swordsman who doesn't speak often. His skills are unmatched with no challenger. Link is Zelda's champion and her close friend. While there is no word of romance between Link and Zelda, it is known that the duo shares a home together.

entries.name: The Princess of Hyrule
entries.content: Princess Zelda is the princess of the Hyrulian kingdom. Her appointed knight Link is always at her side. It is well known that the princess never goes anywhere without her silent swordsman. She's a kind and passionate person who's also a well versed scholar. Princess Zelda is beloved by all as she's a kind curious spirit who always love to learn more about her world and surroundings. There's also a rumor going around that the Zelda and Link are together.

entries.name: Voe and You
entries.content: Every Gerudo female is required to take a class named Voe and you before they're allowed to leave the village. Since Gerudo village is a female centered town, its leaders have a class that is mandatory for Gerudo's women education. The Voe and you class is about how should a female gerudo act around hylian men to give them a higher success rate of forming a relationship with them.

entries.name: Gerudo Village
entries.content: Gerudo Village is a town within the Gerudo dessert. It's the mainland of the Gerudo people, where all gerudo must return to their hometown at a young age to grow up and mature into a proper warrior. The Gerudo village is female centric as males of any race is forbidden entry. The only male that is allowed easy access towards the village is Link, the silent swordsman and the village's chief best friend.

entries.name: Kara Kara Bazaar
entries.content: Kara Kara Bazaar is a checkpoint settlement in the gerudo desert. Serving as a border for entry and safe passage to the gerduo town. Its a small town with the oasis in the center and a few palm trees that bore palm fruit. While men of all races are not allowed into Gerduo town, some gather around this settlement.

entries.name: Stable
entries.content:
Concept: Stables
Description: Stables are common locations found all over Hyrule. Each one has an iconic wooden structure in the shape of the horse god Malanya which towers high atop the stable itself, making them easily recognizable from a distance. Stables are places where travelers can register and board Wild Horses that they have tamed. In addition, travelers can seek lodging inside the Stable's main room. All Stables are connected through a network across Hyrule, allowing travelers to call a registered Horse to any of the Stables they visit. Stables charge a fee of 20 Rupees each time a Horse is registered and for lodging. All beds are in one room due to the structure's small interior.

entries.name: Lanayru
entries.content:
Region: Lanayru
Subreigons: Lanayru Great Spring, Lanayru Sea, Lanayru Wetlands, Mount Lanayru
Settlements: Zora's Domain, Wetland Stable
Landmarks: East Reservoir Lake, Lanayru Bay, Lanayru Promenade, Lanayru Road, Mount Lanayru, Ploymus Mountain, Rutala River, Shatterback Point, Spring of Wisdom, Upland Zorana, Zora River

entries.name: Kingdom of Hyrule
entries.content:
Location: Hyrule
Description: Once ruled by the goddess Hylia as an unnamed land in ancient times, it became established as the Kingdom of Hyrule by the descendants of her mortal incarnation. The former heart of Hylian civilization, Central Hyrule, suffered greatly from the Calamity's destruction. The Region, along with Hyrule Castle, became inhabited by Guardians and various monsters. The civilizations of Hyrule survived and continue to live in their settlements, with the Hylians in Hateno Village and Lurelin Village, the Sheikah in Kakariko Village, the Zora in Zora's Domain, the Gerudo in Gerudo Town, the Gorons in Goron City and the Rito in Rito Village.
Reigions: Akkala, Central Hyrule, Eldin, Faron. Gerudo, Hebra, Lanayru, Necluda

entries.name: Zonai Survey Team
entries.content:
Concept: Zonai Survey Team
Description: The Zonai Survey Team are a group of adventurous scholars that was formed under Princess Zelda's order to gather as much knowledge as possible to understand the Zonai and their ancient civilization since the Upheaval. They can be found wherever there are Zonai ruins across Hyrule, such as Kakariko Village and the Faron region.
The leader of the team is a man named Tauro

entries.name: Depths
entries.content:
Location: Depths
Description: The Depths is a vast location that mirrors the entire land of Hyrule, but is far underground. Many Chasms have appeared since the Upheaval that lead to this underground place. Very few have ventured down to the Depths as there is no easy way back up to the surface aside from hot air balloons. Many monsters populate the Depths, however there are several Zonai ruins, such as mines and two temples: The Fire temple and the Spirit Temple. Gloom is prevalent in the Depths, which is known to make anyone who touches it very sick.

entries.name: Sky Islands
entries.content:
Location: Sky Islands
Description: The Sky Islands are island formations that float far above Hyrule's surface. This is where the most Zonai ruins and structures stand, including the notable Temple of Time, Wind Temple, and Water Temple. Very few have managed to venture up to these islands because they are so high up, but can be visible from the surface. After the Upheaval, many pieces and ruins of these islands have fallen to the surface across the kingdom.

entries.name: Dragons
entries.content:
Creature: Dragons
Description: Dragons are mythical benevolent spirits that fly in the sky and can only be seen by those blessed by the Goddess Hylia. They are giant creatures with very long serpentine bodies and claws which they use to assist in their movement across the sky, as well as horns.
The three dragons are: Dinraal the fire dragon who travels around the Eldin region, Farosh the Electric dragon who travels the Faron region as well as the Gerudo Highlands, and Naydra the Ice dragon who travels around the Lanayru region. While these dragons are invisible to the average Hyrulean, it is said that their shadows can be seen as they pass over.
There is a fourth dragon, the Light Dragon. Little is known about this creature but it is said that it possesses the Light element.

entries.name: Gorons
entries.content:
Race: Goron
Description: The gorons are a race of rock people that primarily live in the Eldin region. They thrive on rocks for their diet and do not eat anything else. They have the capability to thrive in any environment, and in times of crisis, have survived by migrating to different climes. They are notable for having a lack of identifiable female members.

entries.name: Rito
entries.content:
Race: Rito
Description: The Rito are a race of bird folk whose main home is in the Tabantha Frontier in the Hebra Region. The Rito are anthropomorphized birds, covered in feathers with wings for arms and possessing beaks and a talon. Their feathers are known for keeping them warm in cold climates, making it easier for them to thrive in lower temperatures.

entries.name: Akkala
entries.content:
Region: Akkala
Subregions: Deep Akkala, Akkala Highlands
Settlements: Tarrey Town, East Akkala Stable, South Akkala Stable, Akkala Ancient Tech Lab
Landmarks: Spring of Power, Skull Lake, Ordorac Quarry, Torin Wetlands, Lake Akkala, Akkala Falls, Akkala Citidel Ruins, Ulria Grotto, Rist Peninsula, Lomei Labrynth Island, Bloodleaf Lake

entries.name: Hebra
entries.content:
Region: Hebra
Subregions: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Frontier
Settlements: Rito Village, Snowfield Stable, Lucky Clover Gazette, Hebra Trailhead Lodge
Landmarks: Lake Totori, Hebra Peak, Hebra Falls, Hebra Plunge, Hebra Tundra, Icefall Foothills, Hebra North Crest, Hebra Great Skeleton, Coldsnap Hollow, Biron Snowshelf, Stumida Basin, Lake Kilsie, Dronoc's Pass, Rospro Pass, North Lomei Labrynth, Great Fairy Fountain

entries.name: Eldin
entries.content:
Region: Eldin
Subregions: Eldin Mountains, Eldin Canyon, Death Mountain
Settlements: Goron City, Foothill Stable
Landmarks: Death Mountain, Maw of Death Mountain, Lake Ferona, Lake Intenoch, Goronbi Lake, Goron Hot Springs, Darunia Lake, Eldin's Flank, Eldin Great Skeleton, Gut Check Rock, YunoboCo HQ

entries.name: Faron
entries.content:
Region: Faron
Subregions: Faron Grasslands, Faron Sea, Faron Rainforests
Settlements: Highland Stable, Lakeside Stable, Lurelin Village
Landmarks: Lake Hylia, Lake of the Horse God, Horse God Bridge, Faron Woods, Zonai Ruins, Dracozu River, Dracozu Lake, Spring of Courage, Floria River, Lake Floia, Floria Falls, Riola Spring, Mount Floria, Tuft Mountain, Cape Cales, Eventide Island, Tobio's Hollow, Cherry Tree

entries.name: Gerudo Region
entries.content:
Region: Gerudo
Subregions: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Highlands
Settlements: Gerudo Town, Gerudo Canyon Stable
Landmarks: Gerudo Canyon, Gerudo Desert Gateway, East Gerudo Ruins, Spectacle Rock, Cherry Tree, Mount Nabooru, West Gerudo Ruins, North Gerudo Ruins, North Gerudo Icehouse, Desert Rift, Great Cliffs, Palu Wasteland, Gerudo Great Skaleton, Lightning Temple, Southern Oasis

entries.name: Aerocuda
entries.content:
Monster: Aerocuda
Description: An airborne monster that can be recognized by its distinctive cries. They have strong, dexterous feet and can often be seen cruising through the sky with animals or other monsters in their clutches. Thankfully, the breed's lightweight, aerodynamic body makes it easy to shoot down.

entries.name: Battle Talus
entries.content:
Monster: Battle Talus
Description: Monsters have built structures onto this Talus to create what might be called a moving fort. Its body is reinforced with wooden planks to keep away enemies. It can't be easily climbed.

entries.name: Bokoblin
entries.content:
Monster: Bokoblin
Description: This common species is a nuisance all over Hyrule. Some have unified in the time following the Great Calamity and have formed factions of bandits. While not very clever, they are at least intelligent enough to hunt beasts and grill the meat for food. Though they're typically ferocious carnivores, they actually enjoy fruit as well.
Color Variants: Red, Blue, Black, Silver, Golden

entries.name: Boss Bokoblin
entries.content:
Monster: Boss Bokoblin
Description: These heavyweight monsters are leaders of Bokoblins. They swagger about, whistling commands to the teams of minions nervously trailing them. Their heavy horns are so sharp, they can slice large trees clean in half.
Color Variants: Red, Blue, Black, Silver

entries.name: Bubbulfrog
entries.content:
Monster: Bubbulfrog
Description: These mysterious creates dwell in caves all around the world. They like to stay hidden and will spew bubbles when threatened. When overcome, they disappear and leave behind mysterious objects.
Drops: Bubbul Gem

entries.name: Captain Construct
entries.content:
Monster: Captain Construct
	Description: An elite Soldier Construct, hence its "captain" title. Made by the Zonai with advanced techniques and magic. As a standard-rank member of the captain class, its combat functions are more sophisticated than those of Soldier Constructs. It can use Fuse to enhance its weapons.

entries.name: Chuchu
entries.content:
Monster: Chuchu
Description: This low-level, gel-based monster can be found all over Hyrule. It tends to spring its attacks on unsuspecting prey from the ground or from trees. Its strength varies by size, and the type of jelly it drops varies depending on whether the Chuchu was heated up, cooled down, or shocked.
Elemental Variants: Electric, Fire, Ice

entries.name: Electric Wizzrobe
entries.content:
Monster: Electric Wizzrobe
Description: These spell-casting monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They hurl multiple balls of electricity, summon monsters surging with electricity, and have been known to cause thunderstorms in the area. They are more resilient and dangerous than Electric Wizzrobes.
Skill Variants: Thunder Wizzrobe

entries.name: Evermean
entries.content:
Monster: Evermean
	Description: A monster that mimics a tree, found throughout the forests of Hyrule. These imposters are hard to differentiate from the genuine article, making it easy for them to team up and pounce on unsuspecting passersby. Because the species shares characteristics with trees, it can be chopped down in much the same way.

entries.name: Fire Wizzrobe
entries.content:
Monster: Fire Wizzrobe
Description: These spell-casting monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They hurl fireballs, summon flaming monsters, and have been known to severely raise the temperature around them. The weather will normalize once the Wizzrobe is defeated.
Skill Variants: Meteo Wizzrobe

entries.name: Forest Octorok
entries.content:
Monster: Forest Octorok
Description: Although originally an aquatic species, this type has adapted to life in the forest. They hide among the trees, disguising themselves as grass or unassuming shrubbery, and then attack when someone wanders by.

entries.name: Frox
entries.content:
Monster: Frox
Description: A large monster that dwells in the Depths. Despite its unwieldy body, it has incredibly powerful legs that it can use to leap from afar to capture prey. Its large mouth allows it to swallow whatever it hungers for in one gulp.
Color Variants: Obsidian, Blue-White

entries.name: Flux Construct
entries.content:
Monster: Flux Construct
Description: A construct composed of interconnected blocks, made by the Zonai with advanced techniques and magic. It can rearrange the blocks to change its shape at will. To provide sufficient energy to power its gigantic form, this construct contains a massive store of Zonai charge.

entries.name: Gerudo
entries.content:
Gerudo
Description: The Gerudo are a race of only women who live in Gerudo Desert. Male Gerudo are extremely rare, said to be born only once every century. It is said that Calamity Ganon once took the form of a male Gerudo in the ancient past, yet no other male has been born since. The Gerudo women are tall with a muscular physique, typically with darker skin and red hair. They do not allow men into their village, instead leaving their home in search of husbands.

entries.name: Gibdo
entries.content:
Monster: Gibdo
Description: A monster that appeared along with the sand shroud. Though slow to move, they can fight without faltering to physical attacks thanks to their tough outer skin. On the other hand, they are vulnerable to fire and lightning, which can turn them white and brittle.

entries.name: Gleeok
entries.content:
Monster: Gleeok
Description: This giant three-headed flying dragon monster first appeared after the Upheaval. Fighting it alone is inadvisable, as its three heads will attack you all at once. 
Elemental Variants: Thunder, Flame, Frost, King

entries.name: Gloom
entries.content:
Concept: Gloom
Gloom is a viscous, oozing substance that drains the life of its victims. Anyone who is exposed to it i.e. touches the substance, it can cause permanent damage and even kill anyone who is exposed for too long. It's said that even Link himself was nearly killed by Gloom. Less severe exposure to Gloom is reversible, however only under certain conditions: traveling to a Lightroot, standing in direct sunlight, or consuming meals cooked with a Sundelion or Sun Pumpkin.
Following the Upheaval, it has been found in vast quantities in the Depths and around chasms on the surface.

entries.name: Hinox
entries.content:
Monster: Hinox
Description: These giant, one-eyed monsters live mostly in the woods and have large, thick horns. Hinox are known for tearing entire trees from the ground and using them as weapons. Occasionally, they fall asleep on roads, presenting terrifying roadblocks for travelers. A deft hand can steal weapons from the necklaces they wear.
Color Variants: Red, Blue, Black

entries.name: Ice Wizzrobe
entries.content:
Monster: Ice Wizzrobe
Description: These spell-casting monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They create freezing blasts of air, summon frozen monsters, and have been known to cause blizzards to severely decrease the temperature around them. The weather will normalize once the Wizzrobe is defeated.
Skill Variants: Blizzrobe

entries.name: Keese
entries.content:
Monster: Keese
Description: The unpredictable flight pattern of this nocturnal, bat-like species can make fighting them a nuisance, but they're weak enough to fell with a single strike. Sometimes they like to form packs, and they have been seen swarming out of caves together.
Elemental Variants: Electric, Fire, Ice

entries.name: Like Like
entries.content:
Monster: Like Like
Description: A monster that has been appearing all over Hyrule in recent days. Found dwelling in caves and other dark places. It has an appetite for swords and shields. If you get too close, it may lunge at you with its mouth wide, swallow you whole, and eat your equipment. The tongue in the center of its mouth is very sensitive. Attack it to make the creature falter.
Elemental Variants: Shock, Fire, Ice, Rock

entries.name: Link
entries.content:
Name: Link
Appearance: Blond hair half-tied, blue eyes, strong but slim physique, often wears blue
Attributes: Strong, courageous, loyal, loves food, a bit of a dork
Description: Link is the Chosen Hero of Hyrule who has saved the kingdom from Calamity Ganon. Rumor has it that he was with Princess Zelda and the four Champions on that fateful day 100 years ago when the Calamity struck, and was put into stasis at a special healing shrine after being dealt a fatal blow. Link is now still alive, however he and Princess Zelda have gone missing ever since the Upheaval. Some claim to have seen them, but they are all only rumors. Link is said to be loved by the Goddess Hylia herself.

entries.name: Lookout Landing
entries.content:
Location: Lookout Landing
Description: Lookout Landing is a settlement built around the Sacred Ground ruins in front of Hyrule Castle. It oversees the castle, and has a Skyview Tower. Knights of Hyrule train here, and there is a mini Stable. Small shops are set up within, as well, such as clothing and food. Just beneath Lookout Landing is the Emergency Shelter, where injured soldiers rest and where the Zonai Survey Team have made their base of operations. All are welcome to take refuge here in the midst of the Upheaval.
Of note, the two renowned Sheikah Scientists, Purah and Robbie, are currently conducting research on Gloom and keeping an eye on the castle. They have built a Research Lab within the Landing, where they have taken temporary residence.

entries.name: Moblin
entries.content:
Monster: Moblin
Description: This heavyweight species of monster can be found all over Hyrule. They're physically very strong, their legs alone strong enough to resist the force of a bomb blast. They're much more dangerous than Bokoblins. In fact, Moblins have been known to pick up Bokoblins and throw them as makeshift projectile weapons.
Color Variants: Red, Blue, Black, Silver, Golden

entries.name: Pebblit
entries.content:
Monster: Pebblit
Description: A very young Stone Talus. Their bodies toughen as they mature, becoming as tough as boulders by adulthood. As a child, however, their bodies are light enough to be lifted and fragile enough to break when thrown.
Elemental Variants: Igneo, Frost

entries.name: Rock Octorok
entries.content:
Monster: Rock Octorok
Description: This octopus-like species of monster lives in volcanic regions. When they inhale, they're preparing to spit out flaming rocks. Be aware of that powerful suction.

entries.name: Rupee
entries.content:
Item: Rupee
Description: Rupees are the currency used in the Kingdom of Hyrule. They are exchanged for goods and services. Different colored rupees have differing values. Green rupees are worth one rupee, blue rupees are worth five, red rupees are worth twenty, purple rupees are worth fifty, silver rupees are worth one-hundred, gold rupees are worth three-hundred. Rupees can sometimes be found in crates and under stones.

entries.name: Snow Octorok
entries.content:
Monster: Snow Octorok
Description: These octopus-like monsters live in snowy fields and disguise themselves as grass. When someone wanders by, they spring into action and attack by spitting snowballs.

entries.name: Soldier Construct
entries.content:
Monster: Soldier Construct
Description: A standard-issue combat construct made by the Zonai with ancient techniques and magic. It faithfully obeys commands and tries to root out any being it deems to be an enemy. The decoration on its head is sharp and cuts like a blade.

entries.name: Stalizalfos
entries.content:
Monster: Stalizalfos
Description: The remains of Lizalfos appear in the dark of the night. They're as sly as ever, even now that they're just some bones stacked atop each other. However, their bodies are much more fragile, and a single solid hit can reduce them to pieces. If a skull remains intact, they will pull themselves back up and continue to fight. They've been known to grab the wrong skull at times, but they never seem to mind...

entries.name: Stalkoblin
entries.content:
Monster: Stalkoblin
Description: The remains of Bokoblins appear in the dark of the night. While they're fragile enough to crumble from a single blow, as long as a skull remains intact, they'll continue to pull themselves back together and go on fighting. Sometimes the body will pick up the wrong skull, but this doesn't seem to be a problem...

entries.name: Stalmoblin
entries.content:
Monster: Stalmoblin
Description: The remains of Moblins appear in the dark of the night. Even the toughest Moblins become fragile when they're little more than a pile of bones, so they'll crumble after just a few attacks. However, as long as a skull remains intact, they'll continue to pull themselves back together and go on fighting.

entries.name: Talus
entries.content:
Monster: Stone Talus
Description: This enormous monster is naturally camouflaged as a rock formation. Neither sword nor arrow can pierce its stony form, but a cunning adventurer knows to scale its body and attack the ore sprouting from its peak. Unlike your average Stone Talus, this type's ore deposit contains a large amount of precious ore, making it a rare find.
Ore Variants: Luminous, Rare
Elemental Variants: Igneo, Frost

entries.name: Treasure Octorok
entries.content:
Monster: Treasure Octorok
Description: These particularly clever monsters bury themselves in deep sand or snow and disguise themselves as treasure chests. Anyone who approaches the chests is attacked. It is said that the treasure chests on their heads are actually parts of these monsters' bodies.

entries.name: Water Octorok
entries.content:
Monster: Water Octorok
Description: Although they spend most of their time in water, they burst out when they sense someone. The rocks they spit out can be bounced back with a shield.

entries.name: Yiga Blademaster
entries.content:
Monster: Yiga Blademaster
Description: These are the elite soldiers of the Yiga Clan. They favor the windcleaver blade and are extremely agile despite their bulky build. At this Yiga Clan rank, they have mastered a technique that allows them to manipulate the very earth. By striking the ground, they can create stone pillars and blasts of air.

entries.name: Yiga Clan
entries.content:
The Yiga clan are an evil tribe of Sheikah descendants who branched away from their Sheikah kin 10,000 years ago, and rebelled against the kingdom, fostering hatred for it.
The Yiga is currently led by Master Kohga. Their goal is to eliminate anyone who opposes Ganon. They are capable of short-range teleportation via magic incantation. Notably, all Yiga have black hair. They also love Mighty bananas.
There are Yiga Hideouts all throughout the Depths and scattered across the surface of Hyrule.
The Yiga do not take kindly to defectors and will hunt them down.

entries.name: Yiga Footsoldier
entries.content:
Monster: Yiga Footsoldier
Description: The lowest-ranked members of the Yiga Clan. They've been dispatched all across Hyrule with a single task: seek out the hero Link and end his life. They're a crafty bunch, sometimes disguising themselves as simple travelers or villagers to get the jump on you. Be wary of suspicious people you encounter. They're very agile and carry a bow and a one-handed sword.

entries.name: Zora
entries.content:
Race: Zora
Description: An aquatic folk who possess fish and amphibian like traits, including fins, webbed feet and gills, which allow them to swim and thrive underwater. The Zora have a range of physical features, resembling a variety of marine life. Sidon himself resembles a hammerhead shark, and the elderly Muzu resembles a devil ray. And as well, King Dorephan's appearance seems to be based on that of a blue whale. They can also be found in a variety of colors. Zora lay Eggs which hatch into tadpole-like young. Their Eggs hatch one to three days after they are laid, provided that the water they lie in is of a proper temperature, and that the Eggs that were laid at the same time are together. While they resemble tadpoles when they first hatch, they become humanoid even before reaching adulthood. Zora are known to have long lifespans. Zora are considered young until they reach triple digits. Zora children age in such a way where even as young adults they can still appear to be children before reaching a growth spurt. As Zora age, they hold themselves to higher standards of speaking as a matter of pride. Zora have a strong sense of duty for history and order. Because they do not travel far from sources of water and are protective of Zora's Domain, they have limited interaction with other races.

entries.name: Zora's Domain
entries.content:
Location: Zora's Domain
Found: In the Lanayru province
Description: The home of the aquatic race known as the Zora. Its design include a number of curving bridges and open spaces, which are often bounded by colonnades instead of walls. The Domain's structure includes large quantities of Luminous Stone, which causes several portions of it to glow softly during the night. The Great Zora Bridge opens into a plaza centered around a statue of Mipha. The far side of the plaza is bounded by the central structure of the Domain. The central opening in the wall leads down a short flight of stairs to a pool containing Fleet-Lotus Seeds and Bright-Eyed Crabs. To the sides of this opening are a shopping center, Marot Mart, and the Seabed Inn. A pair of stairways on the outer sides of these buildings lead to the Domain's second floor, above the stores and shrine, where a large roofed area contains several water-filled pools where the Zora sleep at night. Several Sneaky River Snails can also be found around these pools. Two further flights of stairs lead to the royal throne room on the third level. The Domain is ruled by the family of King Dorephan and his son Sidon. Their princess, who was a sister to the prince and daughter to the king, was Mipha, who was also a deceased Zora Champion of Hyrule, tasked to pilot the Divine Beast Vah Ruta.

entries.name: Master Sword
entries.content:
Item: Master Sword
Description: The Master Sword is a fabled weapon that was once used 10,000 years ago by a hero to seal Calamity Ganon away. This sword existed throughout all those eons without dulling or decaying, rumored to rest deep within the Great Hyrule Forest, and 100 years ago chose Link as its new wielder, proving him to be the Chosen Hero.

entries.name: Zelda
entries.content:
Princess Zelda
Appearance: Short blonde hair, green eyes, often wears blue
Attributes: Wise, kind, helpful, intelligent, smart, adventurous, selfless
Princess Zelda is Hyrule's last member of The Royal Family. She sealed Calamity Ganon away with the help of Link after keeping it at bay with her divine power for 100 years. Notably, she has not aged during that time. Since then, she has been working tirelessly to restore Hyrule and help her people, traveling across the kingdom to do so. She values education. Princess Zelda has gone missing ever since the Upheaval, but there are several rumors of her being seen in a strange Zonai dress.

entries.name: Purah
entries.content:
Purah
Appearance: White hair tied up in a top-bun, red eyes, red glasses
Attributes: Genius, eccentric, hard-working
Description: Purah is a Shiekah scientist known for inventing new Shiekah technology using old, ancient tech found throughout the kingdom after Calamity Ganon was defeated. She created Lookout Landing to keep an eye on Hyrule Castle after the Upheaval, watching for any sign of Link and Zelda's return as well as researching the strange substance of Gloom. She is responsible for the invention of the Skyview Towers.

entries.name: Shiekah
entries.content: Description: The Shiekah are a tribe of people who primarily live in the mountains of Necluda.  They typically have white or blond hair and red eyes. They are somewhat reclusive, keeping to themselves with the exceptions of Purah and Robbie, two renowned Shiekah scientists. In ancient times, the Shiekah created highly advanced technology which could still be found within Hyrule; after Calamity Ganon was defeated, most ancient Shiekah tech has been salvaged by Purah and Robbie and repurposed into new technology.

entries.name: Skyview Towers
entries.content: Description: Skyview Towers are newly created towers invented by Purah all throughout Hyrule, marking regions and acting as a beacon for travelers. They are used to map out the region, which can only be done by a specific device that Purah and Robbie invented.

entries.name: Hateno Village
entries.content: Description: Hateno Village is a town that has largely been untouched by the Calamity and the Upheaval thanks to Fort Hateno far to the west of the village, making it a safe place to live. It is a peaceful farming village at the base of a mountain, and the climate is slightly chilly so the villagers often wear long sleeves. There are windmills strewn about the village, and has a clothing store, a food store, and a dye shop. Princess Zelda has founded a school there for the children, and even has a house that she and Link have lived in. It is currently empty, but the Mayor's wife visits the house daily to take care of it in their absence.

entries.name: Necluda Region
entries.content:
Region: Necluda
Subregions: West Necluda, East Necluda
Settlements: Kakariko Village, Hateno Village, Dueling Peaks Stable
Landmarks: Dueling Peaks, Kakariko Bridge, Ash Swamp, Fort Hateno, Lanayru Promenade, Mount Lanayru, Cherry Tree, Necluda Sea

entries.name: Central Hyrule
entries.content:
Region: Central Hyrule
Subregions: Hyrule Field, Hyrule Ridge, Lanayru Wetlands, Great Plateau
Settlements: Lookout Landing, Outskirt Stable, New Serenne Stable, Wetland Stable, Riverisde Stable, Woodland Stable
Landmarks: Colosseum ruins, Ancient Tree Stump, Sanidin Park Ruins, Forest of Time, Hyrule Castle, Castle Town ruins, Great Hyrule Forest, Typhlo Ruins, Thundra Plateau, Ranch Ruins, Hylia River, Great Fairy Fountain

entries.name: Gloom Sickness
entries.content:
Gloom Sickness is a deadly disease that is contracted by touching Gloom. The disease is lethal and steadily drains the life force of the afflicted. Symptoms worsen when in contact with Gloom, but stall when Gloom is no longer being touched; symptoms may improve while in direct sunlight if the disease has not progressed to late stages.
Symptoms: Lethargy, fatigue, muscle aches, weakness, coughing, shortness of breath. In late stages, the afflicted are too weak to move.
It can be cured by consuming meals cooked with Sundelions or Sun Pumpkins.

entries.name: Horse God Malanya
entries.content: Malanya is the God of horses, a being who rests in the Akkala region. Malanya is said to be capable of reviving horses that have died. The Stables' iconic wooden structure is modeled after this minor deity.

entries.name: Fairy
entries.content: Fairies are small magical creatures that are found in special places across Hyrule, such as Fairy Fountains. They resemble orbs of glowing light with green-tipped butterfly wings. A fairy can heal someone when they are on the brink of death, but they are very difficult to catch. Fairies cannot heal Gloom Sickness.

entries.name: Sundelions
entries.content: Sundelions are a rare flower that have been discovered after the Upheaval. They are believed to originally be grown on the Sky Islands and only thrive in high altitudes, and are therefore difficult to find. These flowers have a special medicinal property that can cure Gloom Sickness, but only when used as an ingredient in cooking. When eaten raw or charred by fire, their properties cannot be utilized.

entries.name: Sun Pumpkins
entries.content:
Sun Pumpkins are a very new variety of pumpkins that are exclusively grown in Hateno Village at present. These pumpkins have the same medicinal properties as Sundelions, but can be sustainably grown and farmed as crops. When cooked, these pumpkins can cure Gloom Sickness.
Sun Pumpkins are available only in Hateno Village and can be purchased for 20 Rupees at the General Store.

entries.name: Great Fairy
entries.content: There are four Great Fairies throughout Hyrule, each at their own Great Fairy Fountain. Their names are Cotera, Kayasa, Mija, and Tera. They are able to strengthen visitors for a price, but won't help just anyone. It is also said that these Great Fairies also have an affinity for music.

entries.name: Great Fairy Fountain
entries.content: Great Fairy Fountains are located in four places across Hylia. The fountains look like a huge flower adorned with gold filigree, the center being a fountain. Within these fountains are the Great Fairies. It is said that when one visits these fountains, a Great Fairy may emerge and strengthen you for a price. Normal fairies can be found flying at these locations.

entries.name: Lizalfos
entries.content:
These quick-witted, lizard-like monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They're a sly species that lurks underwater or uses camouflage to blend in with the environment to launch ambushes. Moreover, they never sleep.
There are several varieties of Lizalfos, including Blue Lizalfos, Black Lizalfos, Silver Lizalfos, Fire-Breath Lizalfos, Ice-Breath Lizalfos, Electric Lizalfos, and very rarely Gold Lizalfos.

entries.name: Great Hyrule Forest
entries.content: Description: Great Hyrule Forest is a large and dense forest just to the north of Hyrule Castle. This forest is surrounded by a moat of water, with only one path of entrance. The forest is also known as the Lost Woods because anyone who tries to navigate through this forest will mysteriously find themselves at the entrance again.

entries.name: Tauro
entries.content:
Name: Tauro
Age: 30
Appearance: Tall, muscled, wavy shaggy brown hair with blond strands, dark skin wears no shirt beneath his vest
Attributes: Passionate researcher, enthusiastic, dedicated
An explorer whose passion for field research is unrivaled. He lives to make big discoveries, and he spent a long time traveling solo, investigating ruins. He is also an expert on reading Zonai writing. Princess Zelda found him to be the perfect choice for leading the Zonai Survey Team.
